name: zinin
description: Agent plugins by zinin for Claude Code, Grok and Codex

plugins.name: mesh-exec
plugins.description: Run a prompt through another model's CLI — Codex, Gemini, Grok, Claude Code, alt-provider models — with logging, a watchdog and run directories

plugins.name: session-relay
plugins.description: Run a plan until the context fills up, pause at a clean checkpoint, and hand the work to a fresh session

plugins.name: mesh-review
plugins.description: Multi-model code and design review from inside the session, for Claude Code and Grok; needs mesh-exec and session-relay, which Claude Code installs with it

plugins.name: claude-md
plugins.description: Write and refactor CLAUDE.md files: size budgets, the three-tier layout, paths: frontmatter, a quality checklist

plugins.name: build-forge
plugins.description: Build/test/lint delegation and JVM/Android dependency updates (Gradle plugins, Google Maven)

plugins.name: atlassian-scout
plugins.description: Jira ticket analysis, Confluence page reading, and cross-repository investigation of bugs and of new work via context-protecting subagents

plugins.name: prd-flow
plugins.description: Idea to PRD to tasks: collaborative PRD authoring plus autonomous refinement of PRD and tasks.json

plugins.name: herdr-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent code review inside herdr: reviewers, an orchestrator and a fixer as visible, interactive agents in their own tabs

plugins.name: codex-base-review
plugins.description: Codex-style PR review against the branch this one was cut from
